result.reason: The operative language satisfies the fallback and substantially reaches the preferred position: it creates a mutual cap equal to the greater of 12 months’ paid or payable Fees and USD 1,000,000, while leaving all specified Excluded Claims uncapped. It also retains the treatment of certain Customer payment obligations as outside damages. The revision is targeted and professionally drafted. It does not fully achieve the preferred position because it contains no mutual exclusion of indirect or consequential damages, and the payment-obligation clarification remains narrower than the playbook because it applies only to undisputed Fees for conforming Services.
